zupdf: Read, Assemble and Write 'PDF' Files

Source: R/zupdf-package.R
zupdf-package.Rd

Opens 'PDF' files and reads their metadata, pages, objects, streams, fonts, images and text in reading order; copies pages between files to split, merge, rotate and reorder them, and sets metadata, permissions and encryption; and writes new 'PDF' files from R with text, paths and images. Uses a bundled copy of the 'pdfio' library (https://github.com/michaelrsweet/pdfio), so no system library beyond 'zlib' is required. Untrusted input is bounded by limits on size, object count, stream size and nesting depth. Pages are never rendered to images.
